trips.note: The batteries died; luckily we noticed mid-voyage. We couldn't return to the marina without the engine, so we spent an hour under sail alone with no bail-out option, until a towing boat helped restart it. Then we motorsailed back safely.

trips.note: Occasional fog, mist and rain, with visibility below a mile (maybe a little less) at times. The most stunning ten-minute sunset when the fog suddenly cleared on the horizon. Practiced navigation after sunset, in the dark (as dark as the Bay gets).

wind.source: Open-Meteo historical forecast, 15-minute, along the track

trips.note: Asymmetric spinnaker handling, rotating through every position: bow, mast, pit, spinnaker trimmer, main trimmer and driver. Practised hoists (port side), inside gybes and windward douses. Got more familiar with the cunningham and adjusting backstay tension.
